quotes.text: And it came to pass that the Lord of the vineyard said unto the servant, come let us go to the nethermost part of the vineyard, and behold if the natural branches of the tree hath not brought forth much fruit also, that I may lay up of the fruit thereof against the season, nnto mine own self. And it came to pass that they went forth whither the master had hid the natural branches of the tree ;…
